content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms rely on centralized systems that exclude creators in regions like Kenya. COREMERCH’s infrastructure is built on decentralized tools that operate independently of these gatekeepers. By using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions, you bypass geographic restrictions entirely. This stack is designed to withstand the very pressures that caused platforms like Stripe to fail you in the first place. It’s not just a solution—it’s a permanent shift to infrastructure sovereignty. You own the code, the data, and the revenue streams. No platform can shut you down or limit your reach. This is commerce infrastructure built for creators who refuse to be locked out.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign commerce stack, gather these essentials: a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting, a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing, and your digital products ready for upload. You’ll also need a domain name (optional but recommended for professionalism). Familiarize yourself with the basics of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, as these will host your storefront. If you’re using the Complete Builder Kit, you’ll have access to templates and blueprints that streamline this process. Ensure your products are formatted for instant delivery—PDFs, ZIP files, or direct download links. Finally, decide which cryptocurrencies to accept (BSC, Solana, or TRON are recommended for low fees). With these elements in place, you’re ready to deploy infrastructure that works for you, not against you.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions. Set up a payment gateway for your chosen cryptocurrencies and integrate the webhook that triggers product delivery once payment is confirmed on-chain. Next, upload your digital products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. These platforms serve as your file delivery system, ensuring customers receive their purchases instantly. Connect your hosting platform—GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—to your backend logic via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This automates the entire process: payment verification, order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets, and file delivery. Test every step manually before going live. The Complete Builder Kit includes pre-built templates for this pipeline, saving you hours of development time. By the end of this phase, your infrastructure is ready to process transactions without your intervention.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure removes geographic barriers entirely.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your storefront to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages and make it live. Share the link with your audience and monitor your NOWPayments dashboard for incoming transactions. When a customer pays, the webhook automatically verifies the payment on-chain and delivers the product. Your first transaction proves the infrastructure is operational. Use this moment to document the process for future reference. If issues arise, refer to the troubleshooting guide included in the Complete Builder Kit. Once live, your stack requires no further maintenance unless you add new products or update pricing. This is commerce infrastructure that runs itself, giving you the freedom to focus on creating, not troubleshooting payments.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your sovereign commerce stack deployed, scaling is straightforward. Add more products to your storefront by updating your backend logic and file delivery system. Use the scaling playbook included in the Complete Builder Kit to optimize performance as your customer base grows. Monitor transaction fees and adjust your accepted cryptocurrencies to minimize costs. Expand your marketing efforts to reach global audiences—your infrastructure is now borderless. As revenue increases, reinvest in your business without worrying about platform fees or restrictions. This isn’t just a solution for today; it’s a foundation for long-term growth. You’ve built infrastructure that scales with you, not against you.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Kenyan creators can get paid internationally by deploying a sovereign commerce stack that uses blockchain-based payments and Cloudflare infrastructure. This eliminates reliance on platforms like Stripe or PayPal, which are often unavailable or restricted. By hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, using NOWPayments for crypto transactions, and automating delivery via Cloudflare Workers, creators can sell digital products globally without geographic barriers. The Complete Builder Kit provides all the tools and templates needed to set this up quickly and efficiently.
NOWPayments processes over 300 cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee.

Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started today. This isn’t a workaround—it’s a permanent solution to the payment barriers Kenyan creators face.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Set up a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting.
2. Create a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing.
3. Prepare your digital products for instant delivery.
4. Configure your payment gateway and webhook for automatic verification.
5. Upload products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery.
6. Connect hosting to backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script.
7. Test the entire pipeline manually before going live.
8. Deploy your storefront and share the link with your audience.
9. Monitor transactions and document the process for future reference.
10. Scale by adding more products and optimizing performance.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I accept multiple cryptocurrencies?
Yes, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. We recommend BSC, Solana, or TRON for low transaction fees under $0.10.
Do I need technical expertise to deploy this?
Basic familiarity with GitHub or Cloudflare is helpful, but the Complete Builder Kit includes templates and blueprints that simplify the process.
What happens if a payment fails?
The webhook only triggers product delivery once payment is confirmed on-chain. Failed payments do not result in product delivery.
Can I use my own domain name?
Yes, you can connect a custom domain to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for a professional storefront.
Is there a monthly fee for this infrastructure?
No, this is a one-time deployment. You own the infrastructure and pay only the 0.5% NOWPayments fee per transaction.
